options.title: Parallel furniture · one fixed TV
options.description: Keeps one fixed TV and avoids diagonal furniture. Still requires head turning. Compare this with the direct-view options. Estimated maximum head turn across the sampled seats: bed 26°, sofa 32°. Freestanding headboard and media joinery; adjoining rooms still to resolve.

options.title: Pivoting TV · two direct views
options.description: Straight-on viewing from either area with one physical TV. Turn the screen between bed and sofa; both cannot watch at once. Estimated maximum head turn across the sampled seats: bed 7°, sofa 13°. Rotation space is reserved. Mounting, cables and mechanism need design.

options.title: Separate lounge · two direct views
options.description: Direct views and independent use; furniture has a clear orientation. Two screens and a low media divider; check daylight in the next stage. Estimated maximum head turn across the sampled seats: bed 9°, sofa 12°. The desk sits behind the bed media divider, beside the south-window zone.
